text:
Jordan (sales): Hey team — starting POC with AcmeHealth today. They asked for a 6-month reserved estimate + burst pricing, SOC2 docs, and help triaging a TS SDK streaming failure behind their corp proxy. Can we swarm?
Maya (AE): I can handle the pricing ask. Timeline: they want numbers by EOD Friday. Do we have a standard uplift for VPC + HSM?
Ryan (solutions): Uplift is +15% for private VPC and +8% for HSM; I'll paste the quick calc once I get expected RPS.
Jordan (sales): They expect ~50 sustained RPS with streaming (mixed short/long responses). Also asked whether rolling keys breaks in-stream.
Priya (eng): For streaming, key rotation is handled at the control plane — in-progress requests keep their session token. Not the root cause. What error are they seeing?
Elena (customer eng): Repro steps from their infra: app -> corp-proxy -> internet. Using our TS SDK v1.4.3. Stream starts, then after ~20-30s the client sees `ERR_SOCKET_CLOSED` and the server logs show `client_pool: connection reset by peer`.
Priya (eng): That smells like an idle timeout in the proxy. Our SDK defaults: `socket timeout = 60s` but some proxies close earlier on chunked streaming. Quick workaround: enable HTTP keep-alive + smaller chunk intervals.
Priya (eng): Example config suggestion for TS SDK:
```
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  timeoutMs: 120000,
  streamChunkIntervalMs: 2000,
  httpAgentOptions: { keepAlive: true }
});
```
Maya (AE): Can we give them an explicit config snippet to try ASAP? I'll relay to the customer.
Priya (eng): Yes. Also add `Connection: keep-alive` and set `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` explicitly if their proxy strips it. If they can't change proxy, we can enable a ping frame every 10s in-stream.
Adam (security): On the SOC2 / security questionnaire: we can provide SOC2 Type II, ISO27001 certs, and a short note on key rotation behavior. They also asked for IP allowlist ranges and SSO metadata. We'll need their SP metadata to set up SAML test.
Jordan (sales): I have the questionnaire PDF. Will forward SP metadata once they share. Any blockers for sharing certs?
Adam (security): No blockers; redact customer-specific logs. I'll send a link to the secure doc bucket (s3://redwood-secure/pocs/acme) and grant read access to acme@somedomain.com for 7 days.
deploy-bot: Quote Q-9876 created for "AcmeHealth - 6mo Reserved + VPC" (owner: Maya). :white_check_mark:
Ryan (solutions): For cost sizing: 50 RPS streaming with median 150 tokens/response = estimate ~2.25M tokens/day. With batching and KV cache we recommend Dedicated cluster with 2 nodes (A100/G5 equivalent) and burst pool of 1 node. I'll add expected latency SLOs.
Maya (AE): Please include a line item for eval credits and a prorated setup for the first month.
Priya (eng): Back to the streaming failure — can the customer attach the raw client logs (debug) and the proxy logs showing the TCP teardown? We need headers around the stream to confirm `Connection` and chunking behavior.
Elena (customer eng): I asked them to dump `node --trace-warnings` logs and proxy `access.log` slices. They sent a snippet: 
```
[2026-03-20T14:12:21Z] streamId=xyz status=200 chunk=1
[2026-03-20T14:12:41Z] streamId=xyz err=ERR_SOCKET_CLOSED client_ip=10.1.2.3
```
Priya (eng): That 20s gap aligns with corp-proxy's `idle_timeout=20s`. If they can't change it, set `streamChunkIntervalMs` to 8-10s so traffic stays active. Also set `timeoutMs` > proxy timeout.
Jordan (sales): I'll ask Acme to try the TS config change now. Also following up on SAML metadata — they'll send later today.
Adam (security): Once we get SP metadata, I'll spin up a test SAML connection in our staging tenant and confirm SSO works. Also note: for Private deployments we require IP allowlist and signed CSA for HSM usage.
Maya (AE): Pricing draft incoming in 2h. Ryan/Priya, can you confirm performance notes for the quote?
Ryan (solutions): On it. I'll add recommended autoscale thresholds and a fallback to hosted model that drops to a smaller model on capacity stress (cost saving).
Elena (customer eng): Customer tried the keep-alive tweak — initial tests looked better (stream stayed alive 3x longer). They will run load test tomorrow and share results.
Priya (eng): Great — if still flaky we can toggle server-side ping frames for the POC. That requires a minor runtime flag; I can open a quick canary.
Jordan (sales): Perfect. Thanks team — swarming complete for now. I'll consolidate action items and attach the questionnaire + logs in the thread.
Maya (AE): Thanks all :pray: 
Adam (security): I'll attach the cert bundle and link once ACL is ready.
deploy-bot: Support ticket #SUP-11245 created and linked to quote Q-9876.
